nodes.question: What innovative approach is proposed by Mimic et al. in locating a disinfection facility for hazardous healthcare waste during the COVID-19 era?
nodes.answer: Mimic et al. propose a novel approach based on the Formation fuzzy TARA-MARCOS and random forest recursive feature elimination algorithm to locate a disinfection facility for hazardous healthcare waste during the COVID-19 era. This innovative method aims to optimize the process and ensure efficient waste management.
